areas.Start and sign-in: Users open the app, sign in, set or enter a PIN and accept pending policies.
areas.Home and messages: Users read the home feed, notifications and messages, and open services, notes and events.
areas.Directory: countries, localities, search: Users browse countries and localities, search the directory and read directory updates.
areas.Directory: households: Users read household details, members, relations and photos.
areas.Directory: supper meeting, OSG, communit: Users read details of Supper Meetings and OneSchoolGlobal (OSG). Links to community business details open a Coming soon screen.
areas.Bookmarks: Users save directory items and open their saved items.
areas.Orbit: Users see Orbit events and their details, such as milestones, helpers, documents and QR codes.
areas.LDM: Users see Lord's Day Meal (LDM) events and contact the event hosts.
areas.Assemble: Users see Assemble events and browse them by country.
areas.Menu, profile and contact: Users open the menu, read their profile, change PIN settings, read policies and send contact messages.
areas.Share: Users share items and open items from a share link.
areas.Deprecated: Earlier personal-event screens that the original app no longer uses.
areas.Shared building blocks: Parts that many screens use again, such as layouts, dialogs, filters and cards.

App_Cache.label: Data cache
App_Cache.purpose: This flow holds one block that controls the cache of user information.
App_Cache.evidence: migration/knowledge/*.md; flow block list in the input

App_Common.label: Start and layout
App_Common.purpose: This flow has the start, sign-in and InvalidPermissions screens, and the shared layout, bottom bar and version blocks.

App_CommonBlocks_Filter.label: Filter and sort sheets
App_CommonBlocks_Filter.purpose: This flow has the filter, sort and more-actions bottom sheets that screens use.

App_Common_Blocks.label: Common parts
App_Common_Blocks.purpose: This flow has common parts such as the notification icon, badges, external links and list loading.

App_Common_Blocks_PopupDialogs.label: Dialogs
App_Common_Blocks_PopupDialogs.purpose: This flow has the dialogs for information, choices, exit confirmation and navigation.

App_Menu.label: Menu and PIN settings
App_Menu.purpose: Users open the menu, the terms and policies list and the PIN and biometrics settings.

App_Menu_ContactUs.label: Contact us
App_Menu_ContactUs.purpose: Users choose a contact subject and read its details. The flow also has the rating parts.

App_Notifications.label: Notifications
App_Notifications.purpose: Users read their notifications. The bell icon opens this screen when the flag C2NewNotifications is on.

App_PIN.label: PIN
App_PIN.purpose: Users register, enter or change the PIN of the app.

App_Policies.label: Accept policies
App_Policies.purpose: Users accept pending policies. Many screens send the user here when a policy waits.

App_Profile.label: Profile
App_Profile.purpose: Users read their own profile and a preview of their household.

App_Services.label: Services
App_Services.purpose: Users open the services that the home feed lists.

Bookmarks.label: Bookmarks (new)
Bookmarks.purpose: This flow has the newer Bookmarks screen. It shows only when the flag C2NewBookmarks is on, and the flag is off on TST.

Calendar.label: Calendar and events
Calendar.purpose: This flow has the entertaining events screen and an earlier calendar screen that another screen replaced.
Calendar.evidence: board reasons of MyCalendar and MyEntertaining

Calendar_Events.label: Event cards
Calendar_Events.purpose: This flow has the event card and list parts for calendar events.

ContactFlow.label: Contact by email
ContactFlow.purpose: Users write an email to a member, OneSchoolGlobal, an Orbit host or helpdesk, or an LDM coordinator.

Deprecated_Calendar_PersonalEvent.label: Personal events
Deprecated_Calendar_PersonalEvent.purpose: This flow has the personal event screens. The flag C2EnablePersonalEvents is off on TST, and only screens that are out of scope open them.
Deprecated_Calendar_PersonalEvent.evidence: board reasons of the five screens

Directory_Caroussel.label: Carousels
Directory_Caroussel.purpose: This flow has the carousel parts that show households and Supper Meetings one by one.

Directory_CommonBlocks.label: Directory parts
Directory_CommonBlocks.purpose: This flow has the empty-state and action parts that directory screens use.

Directory_Household.label: Household details
Directory_Household.purpose: Users read a household, move between households in a carousel and read the relations of a member.

Directory_Household_Blocks.label: Household cards
Directory_Household_Blocks.purpose: This flow has the cards, member lists and photo timeline that household screens use.

Directory_Interchange.label: Interchange statistics
Directory_Interchange.purpose: This flow has one block that shows interchange statistics in the directory.

Directory_Locality.label: Countries and localities
Directory_Locality.purpose: Users browse countries and localities and read the details of each one.

Directory_OneSchoolGlobal.label: OSG details
Directory_OneSchoolGlobal.purpose: Users read the details of a OneSchoolGlobal (OSG) group. An OSG event screen exists but nothing opens it.

Directory_OneSchoolGlobal_Blocks.label: OSG parts
Directory_OneSchoolGlobal_Blocks.purpose: This flow has the numbers, event cards and detail cards for OneSchoolGlobal (OSG).

Directory_Photobook.label: Photobook
Directory_Photobook.purpose: Users look at the photos of a household in a photobook.

Directory_Search.label: Directory search
Directory_Search.purpose: Users search the directory and see recent searches and results.
Directory_Search.evidence: board reason of Search; block names

Directory_SupperMeetings.label: Supper Meetings
Directory_SupperMeetings.purpose: Users read the details of a Supper Meeting and move between Supper Meetings in a carousel.

Directory_Updates.label: Updates
Directory_Updates.purpose: Users read a list of updates with filters. The flow also has the update item parts.
Directory_Updates.evidence: board reason of Updates_SingleList; block names

Home.label: Home feed
Home.purpose: Users read the home feed and open a feed item. The feed content comes from an embedded Feed CMS.

Legacy_AssembleFlow.label: Assemble events
Legacy_AssembleFlow.purpose: Users see Assemble events, browse them by country and read an event.

Legacy_LDMEventsFlow.label: LDM events (V1)
Legacy_LDMEventsFlow.purpose: This flow has the version 1 screens for Lord's Day Meal (LDM) events. TST uses version 2.

Legacy_LDMEventsFlow_V2.label: LDM events (V2)
Legacy_LDMEventsFlow_V2.purpose: Users see their Lord's Day Meal (LDM) events and read an event. An email screen also exists.

Legacy_MyBookmarks.label: My bookmarks
Legacy_MyBookmarks.purpose: Users open their saved items and read the items of one group. Two more screens exist for another branch that TST does not use.

Legacy_MyNotificationsFlow.label: Messages
Legacy_MyNotificationsFlow.purpose: Users read a list of messages and open one message. A message can also open from a push notification or a link.

Legacy_OrbitAdminFlow.label: Orbit admin
Legacy_OrbitAdminFlow.purpose: Orbit administrators see their landing screen and an event. Two more admin screens exist on DEV only.

Legacy_OrbitEventsFlow.label: Orbit events
Legacy_OrbitEventsFlow.purpose: Users see an Orbit event and its milestones, helpers, documents, transport, booklet and survey.

Legacy_OrbitQRCodeFlow.label: Orbit QR code
Legacy_OrbitQRCodeFlow.purpose: Users make a QR code for an Orbit event.

Legacy_Share.label: Share
Legacy_Share.purpose: Users open the share screen for an item. Share links from outside also open the app through this flow.

Map.label: Map
Map.purpose: This flow has the map screen. Its entry icon in Locality_Details needs the flag C2EnableMaps. The flag is off on TST.

Notes.label: Notes
Notes.purpose: Users read their notes and filter them.
Notes.evidence: board reason of Notes; block names

SubLayout.label: Screen layouts
SubLayout.purpose: This flow has the layout parts that browse and detail screens use.

zDEV_Directory_CommunityBusinessBlocks.label: Community business
zDEV_Directory_CommunityBusinessBlocks.purpose: This flow is a development flow for community business details. The live links open a Coming soon screen.
zDEV_Directory_CommunityBusinessBlocks.evidence: board reasons of the two screens

zTemp_Flow.label: Temporary screens
zTemp_Flow.purpose: This flow has a share screen for one bookmark branch and a test screen.
zTemp_Flow.evidence: board reasons of ShareObject and TestOpenShare

decisions.outcome: The LDM version 2 screens are in scope. The LDM version 1 screens are not.
Only the Bookmarks branch that TST uses is in scope. The other two branches are not.
Start, sign-in and PIN screens are in scope. InvalidPermissions is not.
This screen is out of scope. The live links open the Coming soon screen.
This screen is out of scope. No screen shows its only link on TST.
Eight screens with no way in on TST are out of scope. EmailContact and EmailTarget are in scope with the Orbit and LDM families.
Screens that open from the app layout or from the home feed are in scope.
HomeFeed, FeedItemDetail, MessageDetail and MyEntertaining are in scope. The content that other apps embed in them is not in scope.
Orbit and Assemble screens are in scope. They are screens of UBTConnect itself, not of a separate app.
ConnectShare is in scope. It opens the app from a share link.
Notifications and MessageList are both in scope. The flag C2NewNotifications chooses between them.
